chunks: Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja‘far عليه السلام was asked about collected water in the bathhouse from the washings of people, some of which may get onto a garment.
So he said: “There is no harm in it.”

key_terms.غُسَالَةِ: used wash-water or runoff from washing
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm or legal problem in it

ai.seo_question: Is water splashing from collected bathhouse washings onto clothes considered problematic in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that water collected in a bathhouse from people’s washings does not make clothing problematic when it splashes onto it. The Imam’s response indicates permissibility and the absence of objection in this case within the context of ritual purity.
